method: Manual landmark picks on original-resolution photos; coordinates are image pixels, origin top left. Four corner crosses determine a projective map; center cross is withheld. Each edge has two independently picked paper-boundary points near corner-cross projections.
limitations: Approximate picks, blurred/rounded paper edges, unknown lens distortion and sheet flatness. No physical scale, calibrated color or capture rotation. Results describe one sheet. Decimal output is arithmetic precision, not measurement accuracy.
